title: Meeting a colleague
transcript: Buongiorno, mi chiamo Luca. Lavoro con il vostro gruppo. Qual è il suo ruolo?
meaning: Good morning, my name is Luca. I work with your group. What is your role?
grammar: Mi chiamo introduces your name. Lavoro is the first-person present of lavorare. Suo is formal your here.
prompt: Introduce yourself and describe your role.

title: Planning the morning
transcript: La mattina bevo un caffè e leggo i messaggi. Poi comincio a lavorare.
meaning: In the morning I drink a coffee and read messages. Then I begin working.
grammar: Bevo and leggo describe routines in the present. Poi means then.
prompt: Write two sentences about your morning.

title: At the café
transcript: Vorrei un tè, per favore. Questo tavolo è libero? Grazie mille.
meaning: I would like a tea, please. Is this table free? Thank you very much.
grammar: Vorrei is a polite way to say I would like. Libero agrees with the masculine singular tavolo.
prompt: Ask politely for a drink and a place to sit.

title: Changing a meeting
transcript: La riunione è alle dieci. A quell’ora non posso. Possiamo spostarla alle undici?
meaning: The meeting is at ten. I cannot make that time. Can we move it to eleven?
grammar: Non before a verb makes it negative. Alle introduces a clock time. La in spostarla refers to the meeting.
prompt: Explain that you need to change a meeting time.

title: Getting around
transcript: Vado alla stazione in autobus. Il viaggio dura venti minuti. Dov’è la fermata più vicina?
meaning: I go to the station by bus. The journey takes twenty minutes. Where is the nearest stop?
grammar: Vado means I go. In autobus means by bus. Dov’è combines dove and è.
prompt: Describe how you travel to a familiar place.

title: Buying groceries
transcript: Mi servono pane e mele. Preparo la cena per due persone. Quanto costano le mele?
meaning: I need bread and apples. I am preparing dinner for two people. How much do the apples cost?
grammar: Mi servono expresses a need for several items. Costano agrees with the plural mele.
prompt: Write what you need for a meal.

title: Sharing an interest
transcript: Mi piace leggere la sera. Adesso leggo un libro di storia. Che cosa le piace leggere?
meaning: I like reading in the evening. Now I am reading a history book. What do you like to read?
grammar: Mi piace followed by an infinitive expresses liking an activity. Le is formal to you here.
prompt: Describe an interest and ask a related question.

title: Offering help
transcript: Oggi ha molto lavoro. Posso aiutarla dopo pranzo. Da dove vuole cominciare?
meaning: You have a lot of work today. I can help you after lunch. Where would you like to start?
grammar: Posso plus an infinitive expresses ability or an offer. Aiutarla uses formal la for you.

title: Expressing a preference
transcript: Preferisco lavorare in un posto tranquillo. La musica a volte mi distrae. Ma ognuno ha le proprie abitudini.
meaning: I prefer working in a quiet place. Music sometimes distracts me. But everyone has their own habits.
grammar: Preferisco plus an infinitive states a preference. Ma introduces a contrast.

title: Weekend plans
transcript: Questo fine settimana vedrò degli amici. Cucineremo insieme. Se farà bel tempo, mangeremo fuori.
meaning: This weekend I will see some friends. We will cook together. If the weather is nice, we will eat outside.
grammar: Vedrò, cucineremo, and mangeremo are future forms. Insieme means together.
